name: Shanghai Able Digital Science&Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Able Digital Science&Tech Co., Ltd. provides digital teaching and learning solutions for higher education institutions in China. It offers digital educational content services and products, digital courses, knowledge graph, virtual simulation; digital teaching and learning environment services and products, such as AI cloud learning management system, and digital classroom environment services. It serves higher education institutions, including universities, colleges, and vocational schools, as well as teachers, and students.
